title: Equivariant Milnor map
summary: The Milnor map is the homomorphism from the unitary bordism ring to the unoriented bordism ring, halving the dimension, that maps the unitary bordism classes of the complex Milnor hypersurfaces to the unoriented bordism classes of their real points. In this work, we propose to generalize this construction to the equivariant setup and we show the existence of such a map for the equivariant unitary groups of the circle and the cyclic group of order two. Furthermore, we relate the kernel of these Milnor maps to the magnetic unitary equivariant bordism groups of free conjugations.
